observations: Photos show a removed vehicle drivetrain assembly with a large transmission/gearbox casing and attached components/wiring/hoses.
The gearbox appears to be an automatic-style unit (no clear manual shift linkage shown in these angles).
No clear readable brand/model markings are visible on the gearbox casing in the provided photos.
The seller text claims Jeep Wrangler 3.6L 2011 4X4 and 'Direct America drive with low', but this is not verifiable from the photos shown.

claims.evidence: Photos show a gearbox/transmission assembly but no readable Jeep/Wrangler/3.6L/2011 identification markings.
No visible drivetrain label/part number or transfer-case/low-range identification in the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (different Wrangler engine/transmission variant, or different year/4x4 configuration). Photos don’t show a readable part number to confirm compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the transmission/transfer-case ID plate or stamped part number (and any Jeep part number) plus the VIN/engine code of the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used gearbox/transmission with unknown compatibility (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Condition unknown (could be non-working, missing sensors/solenoids, or damaged internals). Photos show a removed unit but no test evidence.
risks.proof: Video of the unit being tested/bench-run (or at minimum: photo of fluid condition + all connectors/sensors present, and a receipt/test note from the dismantler).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: treat as for spares/repair).

risks.risk: Missing components/accessories (harness connectors, cooler lines, torque converter, transfer-case parts). Photos don’t confirm completeness.
risks.proof: Lay-out photo showing every included part with a checklist (bellhousing/adapter, sensors, shifter/selector parts, cooler lines, bolts, harness connectors).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: assume missing small parts).

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history unknown; could be from accident/overheating leading to hidden damage.
risks.proof: Donor vehicle details (mileage, reason for removal) and any tag/label on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average-wear unknown (worst case: assume heavy wear).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the gearbox/transfer-case ID plate or stamped part number (photo 0/2 area) so we can match exact Wrangler 3.6L 2011 4x4 variant.
Photo showing all included parts and connectors (especially sensors/solenoids/harness plugs) laid out, to confirm completeness.
Evidence it works: short video of bench test or confirmation from dismantler with test result (or at least fluid drained/condition + no leaks).
Donor vehicle details: VIN (last 6 digits ok) or engine/transmission code and mileage, plus reason for removal.
response.reason: The photos show a gearbox/transmission assembly, but there is no readable part number or clear identification to confirm the exact Jeep Wrangler 3.6L 2011 4x4 'low' variant, and there is no proof of working condition or completeness—so a worst-case price cannot be safely matched to the comparables.
